info.title: Fabric IQ Ontology Data Agent (Auto FNOL Triage)
info.description: NOTE: The real Fabric IQ endpoint is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) streamable-HTTP endpoint, not a plain REST/OpenAPI endpoint - see ../../Auto_FNOL_solution/fabric/test_mcp_dataagent.py for the working MCP client pattern (mcp_url = https://api.fabric.microsoft.com/v1/mcp/workspaces/{workspace_id}/dataagents/{data_agent_id}/agent, auth via AzureCliCredential/DefaultAzureCredential token for https://api.fabric.microsoft.com/.default). This OpenAPI file is kept ONLY as a fallback shape for Foundry's OpenAPI-tool authoring surface if/when it does not yet support wiring an MCP tool directly; the RECOMMENDED integration is to use Foundry's native MCP tool type. See foundry/create_orchestrator_agent.py for both wiring paths.

post.summary: Query the AutoFNOL_Ontology graph (Policyholder, Vehicle, Adjuster, RepairShop, Policy, Claim, FraudSignal, SubrogationFlag) with a natural-language question.

question.description: Natural-language question, e.g. 'Show coverage limits for Policy POL-00005'.

200.description: Structured answer grounded in the ontology graph.
